title: Carnival Hoops
blurb: Every support email is a round at four hoops: Urgent, Refund, Angry and Needs human. Each racer throws a ball into every hoop it says yes to.
lesson: Fan-out asks many yes or no questions about one text in a single call: a close race on accuracy, with Jev answering all four tags fast and cheaply.
why: Tagging one email four ways would take four calls if each question went alone. Fan-out sends all four Nouls with the same email in one Jev call, and every tag still gets its own probability.
A swish is a right yes, a rim-out is a yes that should have been no, and a dashed ball is a yes the racer never threw. A round counts as right only when all four hoops are right.
